functions.name: GetPropertyData
functions.description: Retrieves detailed property information including characteristics, assessed values, sales history, and improvement details

propertyId.description: The property identifier (parcel number, property ID, or address)

includeHistory.description: Whether to include sales history and previous assessments

includeImprovements.description: Whether to include detailed improvement (building) information

functions.name: GetComparableSales
functions.description: Finds comparable property sales based on specified criteria including property type, size, age, location, and sale date

propertyType.description: Type of property to search for

buildingAge.description: Target building age in years (will search ±10 years)

location.description: Property address or area to search near

maxDistance.description: Maximum distance in miles from location

saleDate.description: Start date for sales (defaults to 24 months ago)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of comparables to return

functions.name: CalculateDepreciation
functions.description: Calculates property depreciation using the age-life method based on actual age, effective age, and total economic life

actualAge.description: Actual age of the building in years

effectiveAge.description: Effective age considering maintenance and condition (can be less than or greater than actual age)

economicLife.description: Total economic life expectancy of the building in years (typically 40-60 years for commercial, 50-100 years for residential)

replacementCost.description: Current replacement cost of the improvement (optional, for calculating depreciated value)

functions.name: GetMarketTrends
functions.description: Retrieves market statistics and trends for a specific property type and time period, including median prices, price per square foot, and sales volume

endDate.description: End date for trend analysis (defaults to current date)

location.description: Specific area or neighborhood (optional, defaults to county-wide)

groupBy.description: How to group the trend data

functions.name: CalculatePropertyTax
functions.description: Calculates estimated property tax based on assessed value and current levy rates for all taxing districts

assessedValue.description: Current assessed value of the property

propertyId.description: Property identifier to determine applicable taxing districts

taxYear.description: Tax year for calculation (defaults to current year)

includeBreakdown.description: Whether to include detailed breakdown by taxing district

functions.name: GetLevyRates
functions.description: Retrieves current levy rates for all taxing districts applicable to a property location

propertyId.description: Property identifier to determine applicable taxing districts

taxYear.description: Tax year for levy rates (defaults to current year)
